overrides_used.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-12), Note 14 Long-Term Stock Incentive Plan (p. F-30): 'The Company recognized equity-based compensation expense of $28.0 million for the year ended December 31, 2025.' The same note in the FY2024 10-K reports $23.2 million for FY2024 and in the FY2023 10-K $17.3 million for FY2023 — EDGAR companyfacts carries no ShareBasedCompensation annual fact for 2023-2025 (the tag was last filed for FY2009), so the expense is disclosed only in this note.

Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-12), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (p. F-6): the investing-activities section lists only payments/proceeds on securities, loans, MSR and interests in MSR, reverse repurchase agreements and JV distributions for FY2025, FY2024 and FY2023 — there is no purchases-of-property-and-equipment (or any PPE capex) line in any of the three years, and the balance sheet carries no property-and-equipment line (engine ppe_net is blank for every year). The statement fully reconciles without one (dollars in thousands): FY2025 operating 692,911 + investing (27,362,734) + financing 27,219,634 = the reported net increase in cash 549,811 exactly; FY2024: 3,310,659 - 14,984,830 + 11,750,050 = reported 75,879 exactly; FY2023: 2,367,203 - 8,415,890 + 5,884,121 = reported (164,566) exactly. EDGAR companyfacts for CIK 1043219 contains no PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment fact in any year.
